title: Resolved screen recipe options
description: What `mdux-meduic` was asked to do: the source, the panel it is drawn for, the budget it may draw within, and every table the compile was checked against. Describes the **resolved** option set a baker records in `report.json`'s `options`, with every default expanded - not the literal TOML a recipe file carries. ADR-007 decision 4 is why: a silently changed default must not leave every report looking unchanged, so the report records what the bake actually did, and this documents that. Checked against every committed report by tools/docs-lint/check_schema_type_drift.py.

id.description: The artifact id. A screen's name in the grammar is CamelCase and an artifact id is lowercase; the recipe records the pairing rather than the compiler deriving it, because a slug cannot be derived injectively from a name.

surfaceWidth.description: The panel width the screen is compiled for. Declared by the product rather than taken from the source, so a screen drawn for another panel is a diagnostic rather than a silently rescaled frame.

surfaceHeight.description: The panel height, under the same rule as `surfaceWidth`.

budget.description: What the runtime may draw for this screen. Declared rather than computed: the cost model that would let a compiler compute it belongs to the runtime, and until then a declared ceiling is the honest form. `DrawList` fails closed against these numbers.

maxCommands.description: Draw commands the frame may record.

fontPackage.description: Repository-relative path to the committed font package every box is measured with. **Deliberately without a `minLength`, unlike every other path in this schema**: it is empty for a screen that carries no text, which needs no font to measure against and approves no locale. `Recipe::fontPackage` says the same ('committed font package.json, or empty'), and a floor here would refuse a textless screen the compiler accepts. The member is emitted unconditionally rather than omitted so that every screen report has one shape.

items.description: Repository-relative path to a committed text package.

textPackages.description: One package per locale the font approves. A locale approved with no package listed here is a build error rather than a narrower guarantee.

items.description: Repository-relative path to a committed image package.

imagePackages.description: The baked images this screen may name with `img("id")`.

dynamicText.description: The product's governed dynamic-text table, resolved. A report that named a table without recording its contents would say which table a screen was checked against and not what that check was of.

name.description: The dynamic-text source's name, as a component's `source:` field names it.

produces.description: The code points this source can produce, as closed ranges. The compiler checks the font package can draw all of them.

numericTemplates.description: What each `template:` a NumericDisplay names renders as, resolved. `#` is a digit slot and every other character is a literal, which is why the slot character is not a letter.

name.description: The template id a component names.

rendering.description: What it renders as, for example `##.# mmHg`.

verification.description: What the rendered-truth stage was asked to cover.

items.description: A locale tag rendered and checked.

locales.description: The render scopes. Derived from the screen's own approval manifest rather than supplied, so a run cannot narrow what it reports on.
